name: Cup with Dragon Handles
dimensions: Diameter: 14.6 cm (5 3/4 in.); Overall: 4.6 cm (1 13/16 in.)
summary: Three dragons, auspicious symbols for good fortune, grasp the rim of this bowl. A large shou (longevity) character is visible on the outside wall.
